name: Drona
summary: Abhishek Bachchan's warrior guardian in the 2008 Hindi fantasy Drona, directed by Goldie Behl, with Priyanka Chopra as Sonia, mixing Indian martial arts with a big effects push.
origin: Aditya, played by Abhishek Bachchan, grows up with a foster family and finds out he belongs to a line of warriors who protect a mystical source of cosmic energy tied to the amrit, a sacred nectar. The villain Riz Raizada, played by Kay Kay Menon, wants that amrit and believes he must beat Drona to get it. Goldie Behl directed and co-wrote the 2008 Hindi film, which blends Indian martial arts with effects-heavy fantasy; Amitabh Bachchan was among the producers.
powers: Cosmic energy tied to a guardian bloodline
Kalaripayattu, Chhau and Gatka fighting styles

storyline.title: A guardian bloodline
storyline.beat: Aditya discovers he is the latest in a line of warriors guarding a mystical source of cosmic energy, tied to the amrit.

storyline.title: Riz Raizada wants the amrit
storyline.beat: A rival played by Kay Kay Menon sets out to take the amrit, and knows he must beat Drona to get it.

storyline.title: Indian martial arts
storyline.beat: Fights draw on Kalaripayattu, Chhau, Gatka and sword work, with a train-top horse leap as a stunt highlight.

storyline.title: Released in cinemas
storyline.beat: The film opened on 2 October 2008, earned less than its reported budget, and no sequel followed.

gossip.text: Amitabh Bachchan was among the producers of his son's superhero film.
The film shot an underwater motion-control sequence without waterproofed gear.
Drona was reportedly meant to start a franchise and merchandise line, but it flopped.
The VFX team chose a full 4K digital intermediate over 2K because 2K looked too soft for widescreen.
Drona runs 145 minutes, and Eros International distributed it.

theme.tagline: Ancient steel under a cosmic glow.

timeline.title: Soundtrack released
timeline.note: Dhruv Ghanekar's album comes out on 6 September 2008 on Eros Music.

timeline.title: Drona released
timeline.note: Goldie Behl's film opens in cinemas on 2 October 2008.

timeline.title: Box-office disaster
timeline.note: The film earns under Rs 15 crore against a budget of roughly Rs 43 to 45 crore and gets no sequel.

timeline.title: Franchise hopes recalled
timeline.note: In September 2022 Eastern Eye recalls that Drona was meant to kick off a franchise and merchandising but failed.

facts.text: One standout sequence has the villain Riz turn Aditya's mother, Queen Jayanti, into a statue, and another set piece unfolds on a train.
In one stunt the hero jumps from the roof of a moving train onto a horse, and the filmmakers had to work out practical ways to pull it off.
Eastern Eye says Drona was meant to kick-start a franchise and merchandising, but its failure did huge damage to the superhero genre in Hindi cinema.
Bollywood Hungama calls Riz Raizada an evil sorcerer and says the film makes him a descendant of the Asuras; he wants the amrit and believes he must beat Drona to get it.
Riz does not know who Drona is until he meets Aditya and spots the kada, a bracelet, on his wrist, which gives the hero away.
Abhishek Bachchan's real parents are Amitabh and Jaya Bachchan, and both worked on Drona: Amitabh as a producer and Jaya as the hero's mother in the story.
Drona cost about Rs 43 to 45 crore, with a big share on effects (around 250 artists, with 60 experts working over six months), yet it earned under Rs 15 crore.
Priyanka Chopra plays Sonia, who saves Aditya from Riz's men and tells him who he really is before taking him to his birthplace.
Drona was filmed in Prague, Bikaner and Namibia, as well as in Maharashtra and Rajasthan.

Rediff's Sukanya Verma gave Drona 2.5 stars, calling it escapist fantasy whose message is that good beats evil and fear is beaten by facing it, while Hindustan Times' Khalid Mohamed called it artless and derivative.
Bollywood Hungama rated Drona 1.5 out of 5, saying big stars and a big effects budget left a film remembered for striking visuals rather than for its story.
Kalaripayattu, one of Drona's fighting arts, has a famed teacher, Kottakkal Kanaran Gurukkal, who helped keep it alive through a British ban and was nicknamed the Dronacharya of Kalaripayattu.
The crew built an underwater motion-control shot without waterproofed gear, one of several practical fixes described by the VFX team.
A NowRunning reviewer found Priyanka Chopra the film's highlight, better at the action than the hero, but felt Kay Kay Menon was wasted as a clownish villain.
Reviewer Subhash K. Jha described Drona as an attempt to bring a Lord of the Rings style of fantasy to Bollywood, although he felt it was underplayed.
Wikipedia's soundtrack listing credits Dean Devlin, a Hollywood producer and director, among the singers of the song Khushi.
Chhau, one of Drona's fighting styles, is a semi-classical dance with martial roots, found in Purulia, Seraikella and Mayurbhanj, and UNESCO listed it in 2010.
DNA reported that the makers spent about Rs 22 crore on the villain's world, covering castle, effects, troops and costumes, which could make Riz Bollywood's most expensive baddie.
Riz's den used a castle rented in Prague, with effects to make it resemble Bikaner Fort; its well-shaped interior was rebuilt at Mumbai's Film City by about 100 workers in two weeks.
About 200 people played Riz's troops, and they shot their scenes in Prague over two months.
Kay Kay Menon says the sword-fighting needed hard training, his first shot was a magic disappearing act, and months of costume and make-up trials produced Riz's final look.
Little Aditya, raised by a foster family, knows only taunts and humiliations until Sonia reveals who he is and takes him to meet his mother.

kidSummary: Aditya grows up thinking he is ordinary, but he is really Drona, a warrior who guards a magical source of cosmic energy. With his friend Sonia he must stop a sorcerer who wants the power.

story.title: An ordinary boy
story.text: Aditya grows up with a foster family and has no idea he comes from a line of special warriors.

story.title: A secret bracelet
story.text: The sorcerer Riz Raizada hunts for Drona and spots the kada, a bracelet, on Aditya's wrist, which shows who he really is.

story.title: Sonia helps
story.text: Sonia saves Aditya from Riz's men and tells him he has a destiny to guard the amrit, a mystical source of energy.

story.title: A queen and a past
story.text: Sonia takes him to his birthplace, where he meets Queen Jayanti, his mother, and learns about his roots.

story.title: The journey begins
story.text: Armed with Indian martial arts such as Kalaripayattu and swordplay, Drona sets out to protect the world from Riz.
